summary: A free, Eventbrite-ticketed contemplative hike across Kanuga's campus trails ending in a Celtic-style Eucharist, offered by Kanuga itself (an Episcopal non-profit conference, retreat and camp center near Hendersonville hosting roughly 35,000 guests a year). Only two dates on record, 70 days apart, with no membership language, named leaders/regulars, or dedicated program page found.

evidence.note: Listing is free, organized 'By Kanuga', described generically ('Join us... for a contemplative, community building hike'), with no mention of members, a club, dues, or returning attendees.
Only 2 events on record 70 days apart (2026-05-30 and 2026-08-08), a sparse one-off cadence rather than a regular standing gathering.

Kanuga's own site confirms it is a large Episcopal-affiliated conference/retreat/camp center (est. 1928, ~35,000 guests/year, 1,400 acres) and lists 20 miles of hiking trails, but has no dedicated 'Celtic Eucharist Hikes' program page in the fetched content.

No Facebook group, Meetup, or other community page surfaced for this specific hike series; it reads as a periodic institutional program open to whichever retreat guests are on campus, not a standing club with a persistent membership.
